execution_settings.quota_exhaustion_policy: Persist completed records, stop the affected provider, and resume only in a later free-quota window. Never enable payment, purchase credit, upgrade a tier, or use a paid fallback.
execution_settings.action_order_policy: SHA-256-seeded deterministic permutation of A0,A1,A2,A3,A4,A6 using run_id

pilot.purpose: Multimodal transport-and-parser capability validation only; pilot responses are not main-benchmark observations and must not be analyzed as such.

full_matrix.execution_forbidden_until: all three zero-cost pilots complete successfully and the registry is frozen executable
